core_question: Do frozen-protocol forecasting gains and GT-relative attention changes support the score-only semantic model? Each is tested independently.
archetype: quantitative comparison grid; paired same-actor map/attention case panels

evidence_chain.stage7d_main_fde_comparison: Overall primary forecasting comparison; Vehicle, Pedestrian and Moving secondary; paired scene confidence intervals
evidence_chain.stage7d_difficult_vehicle_groups: Prespecified Vehicle>5m, NearTurnConnector20, TurningVehicle_GT; unadjusted overlapping secondary intervals
evidence_chain.stage7d_attention_relevance: Frozen Stage3B, Stage7A and selected Stage7D actor-pooled relevance mass; explicit groups and denominators
evidence_chain.stage7d_turn_attention: Correct, opposite and straight connector mass; same 1663 GT-defined turning actors
evidence_chain.three_cases: Illustrations only, not prevalence or causal evidence; matched map, actor, GT and axes

case_selection: TurningVehicle_GT with DeltaMinFDE<0, most negative delta; deterministic identity tie-break
vehicle.moving with DeltaMinFDE<0, most negative delta among unused identities
Vehicle>5m with DeltaMinFDE>0, most positive delta among unused identities
n_definition: full-horizon actor-window targets; scene-cluster unit is official VAL scene
uncertainty: 1000 paired whole-scene bootstrap replicates over150 scenes, seed2022, pooled sums/counts, percentile95CI
VAL_checkpoint_selection: Overall full-horizon minFDE only; no held-out test claims
statistical_risks: correlated overlapping secondary groups; no multiplicity correction; one training seed; illustrative case selection
export_QA: within-canvas text check, inspect final PNGs, verify PDF fonts/text and SVG text nodes
journal_status: experiment report artifacts, not an assertion of final submission compliance
